content.comment_body: In summary, if I want to use the new features associated with [product_name] [version_no], do I need to upgrade my current [product_name] hardware? Or can I simply update the [product_name] engineering software or firmware to [version_no] to access these features? Thank you for your assistance.

The latest features of [product_name] [version_no] are only accessible if you purchase the new [product_name] with the updated hardware. Older versions cannot be upgraded to these new functions through a firmware update, as no such update is available. You'll need the current version of the [product_name] engineering software, specifically [version_no]. If you already have a prior version, you can upgrade it free of charge. The software upgrade is available for download, but please note there are export restrictions. To access the export-restricted download, you must log in and register. What information is required for registration and why is it necessary to provide data for downloading export-restricted software?

analysis.insight_summary: A user is asking whether the new functionality available in [product_name] [version_no] can be unlocked by updating existing hardware or by upgrading the software or firmware alone. The responses clarify that hardware replacement is necessary, and only the engineering software can be freely updated. Additional confusion comes from export restrictions and required registration for downloading the upgrade.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is hoping to enable new [product_name] [version_no] features via a software or firmware update, thus avoiding the need to purchase new hardware.
